name: Union LA x Air Jordan 1 Retro High NRG 'Storm Blue'
story_html: The design of Union LA x Air Jordan 1 Retro High NRG 'Storm Blue' is meant to evoke the look and feel of ‘your old favorite pair of shoes.’ Consequently, the white midsole is treated to pre-yellowing, while the white and blue leather upper is topped with the collar of a red and black Air Jordan 1 colorway. The latter is grafted onto the shoe with zigzag yellow stitching for a DIY look and feel.
